after_snippet:
import sys

# In 83.0.0, Python 3.10+ is required
assert sys.version_info >= (3, 10), "setuptools 83.0.0 requires Python 3.10 or later"

import setuptools
assert hasattr(setuptools, '__version__')
before_snippet:
import sys
import setuptools

# In 82.0.1, setuptools could be imported on Python < 3.10
# This test only runs on Python 3.10+, so it passes on older interpreters in 82.0.1
# but would fail in 83.0.0 if someone tries to use 83.0.0 on Python < 3.10.
# Since we cannot easily test on Python 3.9 in this harness, we verify
# the version requirement is enforced via setuptools' own check.
assert hasattr(setuptools, '__version__')
title: Python 3.10+ requirement enforced at import/runtime
